Description

Study the 200 most-prescribed drugs, organized the way you actually learn them.

These printable, double-sided flashcards cover the Top 200 drugs, grouped by body system and drug family, so related drugs sit together (all the beta blockers, all the SSRIs, all the statins) and patterns are easier to remember.

WHAT'S ON EVERY CARD
Front:
• Drug name
• Warning strip for boxed (black box) warnings and high-alert medications
• Drug class
• Uses
• Mechanism of action (MOA)
• Side effects
• Nursing notes, including the brand name and prescribing rank
• A "My Notes" box for your own memory tricks

Back:
• Drug class, color-coded by body system, for quick self-quizzing

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 200 flashcards, 9 per page (23 double-sided card sheets)
• 139 drug classes across 13 body systems
• Cover page
• Setup page with printing tips and a full color key (13 body systems)
• Printer alignment test with a 1-inch scale check
• Educational-use and terms page
• 51 pages in total
• Two files: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download your PDF files after purchase.
2. Print the alignment test on plain paper to check your printer.
3. Print double-sided on cardstock (flip on the long edge, 100% / actual size).
4. Cut along the dashed guides and start studying.

PERFECT FOR
Nursing students (ADN, BSN, LPN), pharmacy and pharmacy technician students, NCLEX and pharmacology exam review, and new nurses refreshing their pharm knowledge.

PLEASE NOTE
• This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
• Colors may vary slightly depending on your printer and screen.
• For personal study use only. Please do not share, resell or redistribute the files.
• This is an educational study aid, not a clinical reference. Always verify drug information with current references and follow your program's and facility's guidance.
• Not affiliated with or endorsed by the NCSBN or NCLEX.
